sources.title: nlp4bia-bsc/DT4H_Multilingual_NER - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains code and documentation for multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) models developed within the DT4H (Data Tools for Heart) Europe Horizon project. The focus is multilingual clinical NER for disease, symptom, and procedure mention detection.

sources.title: GitHub - Kungbib/swedish-bert-models
sources.snippet: The following five models are currently available: bert-base-swedish-cased (v1.1) - A BERT trained with the same hyperparameters as first published by Google. bert-base-swedish-cased-ner (experimental) - a BERT fine-tuned for NER using SUC 3.0. bert-base-swedish-cased-pos (experimental) - a BERT fine-tuned for POS using SUC 3.0.
